features: Safe Exploration - The aiprotablet Kids Tablet comes with a parental control mode that allows you to filter content according to your child's age, set educational goals and manage screen time limits, creating a safe environment for use without constant supervision

Learn by Play - The tablet comes with the Google Kids Space app and offers a wealth of age-appropriate content. With a Wi-Fi connection and access to Google Play, parents can download educational apps for an engaging and interactive learning experience

Smooth Performance - The Android Kids Tablet comes with a 1024x600 IPS touch screen, Android15 OS (not GO), RK3562 quad-core processor, 8GB memory (3GB + 5GB virtual), 32GB flash memory and a micro SD card slot to store everything you need.

Powerful features - The new 7-inch tablet supports 2.4GHz and 5GHz Wi-Fi for a more stable connection and faster charging speeds. It also includes Bluetooth 5.0, dual 2MPl front and rear cameras, and an FM radio. Improved battery provides hours of use

DURABLE DESIGN - The kids tablet comes with a soft and durable silicone case that resists drops, bumps and scratches for reliable protection. The swivel stand allows the tablet to be positioned vertically or horizontally, ensuring your child's comfort during use.
description: Product Description aiprotablet's latest 7-inch children's tablet with 8GB (3GB physical + 5GB virtual) RAM and 32GB ROM, 2.0GHz high-performance 4-core processor, runs at 100% faster speed. Shockproof case, you can position the tablet horizontally or vertically, 1.2 m all around drop protection. We chose 3000mAh/3.8V lithium polymer battery. Standby time of 72 hours, more than 5 hours of continuous operation. The latest Android 15 operating system, clean pages, easy to operate, supports multiple languages. 7 inch 1024 x 600 LCD touch screen with low blue light, eye protection touch screen, plus pre-installed protective film.
